# Data dictionary — `synthetic_v1`

**Synthetic data.** Generated by `src/data/generate.py` (seed 42, equation `gen-eq-1.0`).

**Grain:** one row per `(month_start, region_id, product_id)`. 60 months (Jan 2021 – Dec 2025) × 6 regions × 3 products = **1,080 rows**. Complete rectangular panel; no zero-unit rows occur with seed 42.

## `monthly_sales`

| Column | Type (Postgres) | Unit | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `month_start` | DATE | — | First day of the month. PK part. |
| `region_id` | TEXT | — | `R01`–`R06`, FK to `regions`. PK part. |
| `product_id` | TEXT | — | `P01`–`P03`, FK to `products`. PK part. |
| `units_sold` | INTEGER ≥ 0 | packs | Units sold in the month. **Forecast target.** |
| `unit_price_inr` | NUMERIC(14,2) > 0 | INR / unit | Average realized **gross (pre-discount)** price. List price rises 4% each January; ~1% monthly noise. |
| `gross_revenue_inr` | NUMERIC(14,2) ≥ 0 | INR | `units_sold × unit_price_inr` (exact). |
| `discount_inr` | NUMERIC(14,2) ≥ 0 | INR | Discounts and rebates; `≤ gross_revenue_inr`. |
| `net_revenue_inr` | NUMERIC(14,2) ≥ 0 | INR | `gross_revenue_inr − discount_inr` (exact). |
| `marketing_spend_inr` | NUMERIC(14,2) ≥ 0 | INR | Planned marketing spend; generated independently of units. |
| `active_accounts` | INTEGER ≥ 0 | accounts | Covered customer accounts (aggregate count, no identities). |
| `competitor_index` | DOUBLE | index | AR(1) around 1.0, clipped [0.6, 1.4]. 1.0 = typical pressure; higher = more competitive pressure. |
| `regional_demand_index` | DOUBLE | index | AR(1) around 1.0 per region, clipped [0.85, 1.15]. Shared by the region's products. |
| `campaign_flag` | BOOLEAN | — | Campaign month (~15% of months, random). |
| `data_source` | TEXT | — | Always `synthetic_v1`. |

Database constraints enforce non-negativity, positive price, first-of-month dates, discount ≤ gross, and exact gross/net reconciliation.

## Dimensions

`regions(region_id, region_name)`: R01 North, R02 South, R03 East, R04 West, R05 Central, R06 Northeast.
`products(product_id, product_name, therapeutic_group)`: P01 Therapy A, P02 Therapy B, P03 Therapy C (fictional, non-specific groups; no clinical claims).

## Files

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `data/raw/synthetic_sales_clean.csv` | Clean panel (source of truth). |
| `data/raw/synthetic_sales_dirty.csv` | Copy with 26 logged anomalies, for cleaning practice only. |
| `data/raw/generation_metadata.json` | Seed, equation version, parameters, SHA-256, anomaly log. |
| `data/processed/monthly_panel.parquet` | Typed clean panel used by all analysis. |
| `data/processed/features.parquet` | One-month-ahead feature matrix (864 rows, targets 2022-01 – 2025-12). |

## Feature matrix (`src/features/build.py`)

Row = target month T for one series; origin O = T − 1. All inputs observed by end of O.

| Feature | Definition |
|---|---|
| `lag_k` (k = 1, 2, 3, 6, 12) | `units_sold` at T − k. `lag_1` is the last observed month; `lag_12` is the seasonal-naive forecast. |
| `roll_mean_w`, `roll_std_w` (w = 3, 6, 12) | Mean / sample std of units over T − w … T − 1 (`shift(1)` then `rolling(w)`). |
| `spend_origin`, `spend_sum_3` | Marketing spend at O; total spend over T − 3 … T − 1. |
| `price_origin`, `competitor_origin`, `accounts_origin`, `campaign_origin` | Origin-month values. |
| `month_sin`, `month_cos` | Target-month calendar position (known in advance). |
| `region_id`, `product_id` | One-hot encoded in the model pipeline. |
| `y` | `units_sold` at T (target). |
